name: bdrhapsody
description: BD Rhapsody or BD Resolve UMI data.

halt_guidance.blocker: BD Rhapsody processing depends on assay type, barcode references, multiplexing/sample-tag design, and optional AbSeq or targeted-panel resources that are not safely inferable from deposited FASTQs alone.
required_inputs: BD Rhapsody assay and cartridge/chemistry version
Matching reference archive plus sample-tag, AbSeq, or targeted-panel files when used
next_steps: Confirm whether the library is WTA or targeted and whether sample tags or AbSeq libraries are present.
Build or obtain the matching BD reference archive and supplemental reference files.
Run the FASTQs with the BD Rhapsody Analysis Pipeline and preserve its configuration and matrix outputs.

recommended_workflows.name: BD Rhapsody Analysis Pipeline
recommended_workflows.role: BD-supported barcode processing, alignment, and matrix generation

halt_guidance.resume: Use the validated BD pipeline output downstream; UniScFlow does not substitute a generic STARsolo command for BD barcode processing.
